answer: A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The atlas counter is kept in lotus and ledge exposes each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3066 identities would post 2889 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
